fui_queue_party_sync: The party is syncing with the coordinator. Try again in a moment.
fui_queue_leader: Only the party leader can start a search.
fui_queue_active: Your party is already searching or has a match.
fui_invite_empty: No pending invites or eligible Steam friends.
fui_invite_failed: Could not send the party request.
fui_support_err_overlay: Steam Overlay is unavailable on this client. No order was created.
fui_support_err_timeout: Steam did not confirm the purchase. Check your Steam purchase history before trying again.
fui_support_err_busy: A previous order is still being processed.
fui_support_err_app: Payments are unavailable in this Steam build.
fui_war_choose_hint: Choose a faction. You can change it only in the next campaign.
fui_war_next_campaign: The next campaign begins 24 hours after victory
fui_mode_war_desc: Battles for the campaign's fronts. Every win moves the front line.
fui_mode_casual_desc: Classic TF2: 12 versus 12 on the maps you pick.
fui_mode_ranked_desc: 6 versus 6 under league rules. Every win raises your rating.
fui_mode_mvm_desc: Six players against waves of robots.
fui_mode_community_desc: Their rules, their maps. The server browser.
fui_mode_training_desc: A map with bots to warm up on.
fui_map_pool_hint: Tick the maps you are happy to play
fui_locker_hint: Pick a slot on the left, then an item
fui_locker_inventory_loading: Waiting for the TF2 inventory from Steam…
fui_locker_inventory_empty: Steam returned an empty TF2 inventory for this account.
fui_locker_no_items: No items match this slot and filter.
fui_locker_equip_failed: This item could not be equipped in the selected slot.
fui_quit_body: Your party will wait for you in the lobby.
fui_war_none_body: The coordinator is not running a campaign. Play casual: the war will open here.
fui_career_no_history: Your matches will show up here.
fui_career_no_ratings: Your rating appears after your first match.
fui_quests_none: Quests appear once the coordinator is online.
fui_quests_sub: Do them in matches: the experience goes to your level.
fui_quests_how_body: Progress arrives with the match result: kills, damage, healing, wins and the classes you played. Leaving a match counts for nothing.
fui_quests_after_match: Progress counts when the match ends.
fui_classdesc_scout: The fastest on the field. Double jump, captures points twice as fast.
fui_classdesc_soldier: Rocket launcher and rocket jumps. Takes a beating, hits an area.
fui_classdesc_pyro: Flamethrower and compressed air: reflects projectiles, keeps people away.
fui_classdesc_demoman: Grenades and stickies. Locks down chokes and wrecks buildings.
fui_classdesc_heavy: The most health and a minigun that does not stop.
fui_classdesc_engineer: Sentries, dispensers and teleporters. Holds ground while the nest stands.
fui_classdesc_medic: Heals and builds ÜberCharge. The whole team wins around a Medic.
fui_classdesc_sniper: Kills with one headshot from across the map.
fui_classdesc_spy: Invisibility, disguises and a knife in the back.
fui_war_no_ops: The front is quiet right now.
fui_war_ev_stage_lost: %1 held %2: the offensive fell back to %3
fui_war_hq_note: Headquarters. If it falls, the war is over.
fui_war_win_next: %1 win: the operation moves on to %3.
fui_war_win_take: %1 win: %2 is theirs and the front moves.
fui_war_win_war: %1 win: the HQ falls and the war is won.
fui_war_lose_back: %1 win: the operation falls back to %3.
fui_war_quiet_front: No operation here. The sector is on the front line: an offensive opens here when more people are at war.
fui_war_quiet_rear: Deep in the rear: the fighting only comes here if the front moves.
fui_war_drag_hint: Drag to turn the planet, wheel to zoom
fui_set_workshop_d: Your maps and items on Steam Workshop
fui_set_create_d: Start a map with your own rules
fui_war_momentum_last: Last chance: one more loss and the offensive breaks
fui_war_no_live: Nobody is fighting right now. Be the first.
fui_condd_lowgrav: Lighter gravity: jumps go higher and further.
fui_condd_quickwaves: Faster respawns: the fight never stops.
fui_soc_empty_global: Quiet in here. Say hi — someone will answer.
fui_soc_empty_clan: Your clan's channel. Call your people to battle.
fui_soc_empty_party: Squad chat: just the people with you.
fui_feed_captured_clan: %1 taken for %2 — front legends [%3] led the charge
fui_feed_support_monthly: %1 now supports the game every month. Thank you!
fui_err_chat_slow: Easy there: wait a couple of seconds.
fui_err_no_channel: That channel isn't available right now.
fui_err_name_taken: That name or tag is taken.
fui_err_not_allowed: You need a higher rank for that.
fui_err_perk_locked: Your clan hasn't unlocked that yet.
fui_err_not_a_member: That player isn't in the clan.
fui_err_support_busy: Your last purchase is still open in Steam.
fui_clan_why: A clan is a squad that stays with you. Play together, level your clan up and unlock what lone wolves never get.
fui_clan_none_yet: No clans yet. Be the first!
fui_clan_leave_body: What you earned stays with the clan. If you lead it, the senior officer takes over.
fui_clan_contract_reward: Reward: +%1 clan XP and +%2 XP for everyone who helped
fui_clan_order_d: Battles in the chosen operation pay +%1 XP to every clan member.
fui_clan_banner_none: Win war battles: your banner goes up over the sector you fought hardest for.
fui_clan_perk_tag_d: Your tag next to your name in the lobby, chat and player list. Your own channel.
fui_clan_perk_brothers_d: +10% match XP when a clanmate fought beside you.
fui_clan_perk_banner_d: Your banner on the war map, over the sector you fought hardest for.
fui_clan_perk_contract_d: A shared goal each week. Everyone who helped gets paid.
fui_clan_perk_order_d: Officers send the clan to an operation. +50 XP per battle there.
fui_clan_perk_gold_d: Your tag shines gold wherever it shows.
fui_clan_perk_legend_d: When your sector falls, the whole war hears who took it.
fui_support_lead: Team Frontress is made by fans. Your support pays for servers, the coordinator and new maps — and buys us time to work on the game.
fui_support_fair: Support gives no advantage in a fight. You can choose to appear on the supporter list.
fui_support_monthly_d: Steam bills you once a month. Cancel any time.
fui_support_cancel_body: Billing stops. Your supporter badge stays.
fui_support_anon: Keep my name off the wall
fui_support_perk_wall: You can choose to appear on the supporter list.
fui_support_wall_empty: The names of people who supported the game will show up here.
fui_support_you: You supported the game — thank you!
fui_support_you_monthly: Monthly support is active. Thank you!
fui_support_pending: Confirm the purchase in the Steam window
fui_support_err_locked: Steam doesn't allow purchases on this account.
fui_support_err_currency: The currency doesn't match your Steam wallet.
fui_support_err_country: Purchases aren't available in your country.
fui_support_err_funds: Not enough funds in your Steam wallet.
fui_support_err_steam: Steam declined the payment. Try again later.
fui_support_err_unreachable: Steam isn't reachable right now. Try again later.
fui_support_unavailable_d: Once the store opens, you can support the game from here.
fui_support_sandbox: Test mode: no money is charged
fui_support_legal: Payments, receipts and refunds go through Steam. Cancel your subscription here or in your Steam account settings.
fui_support_once_d2: A new map for the war.
